system.attitude: If your group faced a problem because you acted recklessly or drew attention to yourself needlessly, gain growth.
system.description:
You live life loudly and intensely. You’re quick to anger, quick to laughter, and grab existence with both hands.

  • Attributes: Add +1 to Might and +1 to any other attribute

  • Skills: Add +1 to Move or Talk.

  • Bonds: When you select bonds in the next step, at least one must be a rivalry.

  • Drive: When you are the first PC to take a turn in a round, regain 1 Spirit.

  • Exhaustion: You easily overdo things, and quickly find fatigue. When you become exhausted, add +1 to Threat if you choose any exhaustion other than Weary.

  • Attitude: If your group faced a problem because you acted recklessly or drew attention to yourself needlessly, gain growth.
